reviewer: architecture_review: execution architecture and junior-maintainer review

blocks.reason: Imports, class and per-visit execution state: stack represents actual nested returns; cancellation is per player, not a global flag.
Constructor stores explicit runtime dependencies without guessed null recovery.
Push root and build first visible segment; an action-only assembly can complete synchronously so no first line is a valid result.
Set cancellation before native interruption, which can itself execute the displayed endAction.
Selected PLAYER line calls this method; selection resets only current frame then appends following content onto selected line.
Named continuation passes the same no-prefix resume operation to both bridges; no extra state.
Carry optional selected line as first/tail, then process current frame while not cancelled; count-zero is normal root completion.
Drain insertion cursor one candidate at a time, pushing child frames or clearing exhausted cursor; parent position remains advanced.
Lazy registration after entering an edge or selecting another; explicit Select nulls Sequence.
Read next step; defer Call/Insert until existing dialogue and actions finish using an invisible bridge; advance before descent to prevent replay.
Line dispatch and first/tail chain construction; normal distinction between empty prefix and accumulated dialogue.
Action without line executes immediately; otherwise append ordered closure to endAction. Capture is a fresh local per loop body. Cancellation check blocks native InterruptDialog side effects.
Call uses explicit registered context or inherits parent; Insert constructs point cursor. Both are authored distinct step types, no fallback repair.
Pause at next choice node, attach choices to existing visible tail or build standalone options for graph contract; no speculative failure handling.
End of a spoken sequence must defer frame completion until last line finishes; bridge prevents native early ending.
Pop completed child, execute content completion, then mark registered identity only. Direct child and root have no event identity.
Only normal exhausted root exits visit; cancellation deliberately avoids completion/outcome business actions.
Weak-reference and Harmony dependencies plus custom dialogue pacing boundary declaration.
Reference-type value required by ConditionalWeakTable; weak keys avoid process-wide strong retention of every past dialogue.
Register pause once for freshly allocated custom line; no redundant Remove or overwrite fallback.
TryGet distinguishes custom lines from native lines because the patch intercepts all native auto advance calls; zero output is unused when false.
Native skip-delay constant names the actual protocol value from the only native skipped auto-advance call; this is not a guessed threshold. Comment explains why the native flag is insufficient.

Do not replace exactly the native fast-skip delay after the native flag was already cleared. Internal Prefix is directly exercised as the real Harmony boundary without reflection or a test-only wrapper.

For the native normal auto-advance call, replace delay only when current line is registered by this framework; leave native unregistered lines unchanged. Native calls supply a current dialogue; no invented null repair.

blocks.reason: UI-only adapter forces start for already selected visitor narrative; the generic player owns when to start, adapter owns native API call.
Standalone choice graph support uses native Dialogue container; not evidence for adding recursive blank-line repair. Existing production retries use selected prefix.
Map author speaker to native NPC/PLAYER/system title. PLAYER marker is an API token, not the player display name.
Allocate native line and set both action delay and auto-advance pacing; separate native timers require both values.
One selected line per outgoing edge; short closure holds this iteration option and selected object and invokes actual option runtime only when entered.
Separate choice carrier is mandatory: native DisplayChoice reads its text, SelectChoice assigns it, then ContinueConversation moves to its next. Carrier is not repeated player speech.

blocks.reason: Native continuation bridge takes an explicit synchronous continuation. Both player continuation points install this bridge rather than restarting the UI.
Create the invisible next line; its start callback clears the current bridge before evaluating the continuation. This preserves the state visible to completion and exit callbacks.

Assign continuation result unconditionally, including normal root completion returning null. Native SetCurrentDialog is only a field assignment and accepts null; the previous next!=null branch was redundant, not a required normal-flow guard. Native ContinueConversation re-reads current after startAction and ends on null.
Immutable action step stores authored callback consumed by player; no null action substitution or extra execution flag.
Distinct immutable content/context/event identity for plain and registered child calls.
Plain child supplies content only, meaning inherit context and no event completion count.
Registered child transfers definition identity and explicit stage context; shared completion accounting uses this identity.
Immutable insertion-point name, resolved at execution time rather than registration.
Three speaker roles are authoring values mapped by adapter rather than game UI types.
Immutable text/speaker/pause payload; no duplicated render or game dependency in sequence data.
Minimal common type enables ordered heterogeneous authored steps; no virtual runtime methods or invented behavior.
Frame owns content identity/context, selected edge, registered sequence, next-node snapshot, step and insertion cursors; each read by current state machine.
Initialize child with entry edge and inherited or explicit context; no fake default entry.
Selecting an option invalidates old sequence and resets step index, leaving next to be replaced by registration.
Synchronously register all edge steps and immediately snapshot ResolveNext, preserving current legacy branch state semantics.
Maintain ordered candidates and one traversal position; playback/context are shared real inputs rather than new global state.
Build insertion-only point candidate set, preserving definition identity; point filtering is authored routing, not defensive recovery.
Stable descending insertion sort: strict greater comparison keeps equal priorities in registration order; elementary loops are readable and bounded by candidate list.
Each candidate visited once, eligible check runs just before child start so preceding actions/children can update state.
Consume only authored nonempty exclusion group and return selected definition; null means ordinary cursor exhaustion.

findings.reason: Native skip flag has already been cleared at OnCurrentTextDisplayed:347 before ScheduleAutoAdvance(0.01f):351. The existing guard cannot preserve skip timing for custom lines.
findings.recommendation: Discriminate the actual native skip-delay call rather than a flag no longer true; add a regression against the native call sequence.
findings.resolution: Exact native skip-delay discrimination replaces ineffective flag check; real Prefix directly covered by three focused boundary tests.

findings.reason: The previous next!=null branch skipped only a redundant null assignment after the same callback had already cleared currentDialog. Native SetCurrentDialog has no null-specific side effect.
findings.resolution: Removed the conditional; preserved the pre-clear and unconditional assignment of resume result. Bridge mechanism remains necessary for native continuation ordering.
